description: Resources that require specialist/human engagement and must NOT receive an automated AWS target recommendation. The tool returns a deferred result immediately — no normalize or recommend tools should be called.

entries.reason: Engage AWS account team and/or data analytics migration partner before choosing any AWS target. BigQuery encompasses warehousing, analytics, ML, and ETL — too complex for automated mapping.
rubric_applied: BigQuery specialist gate — no automated AWS service target
entries.notes: Applies to all google_bigquery_* resource types: dataset, table, routine, data_transfer_config, job, ml_model, etc.
